column1: # The negative-control fixture of the leak check. Each row is one planted case and the verdict it MUST produce.
# negative_control.py runs every row against a scratch repository it builds, and exits non-zero when a case's verdict differs,
# when this file names a case the runner does not know, or when the runner knows a case this file does not name.
# The planted strings are made at run time (each rule's own control string, a freshly generated fake key), never stored here:
# a committed hit would turn this repository's own scans red, and the real controls live only in the private vocabulary.
